title: Inferno
description: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] HP. Whenever you lose HP on your turn, deal [blue]4[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
smart_description: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] HP. Whenever you lose HP on your turn, deal [blue]4[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
notes: Self-damage can be incremented beyond the base value of 1 HP, scaling the HP loss at turn start.
